title: catapodium salzmannii
intro: Catapodium salzmannii, commonly known as Salzmann's oat-grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Catapodium salzmannii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
